about: Check-in chat replies for check-society-suggestions.mjs. Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

gigs, rules out sport.message: Gigs and live music. Not sport. A gig, then out with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gigs, rules out sport.reply: If you love gigs and nights out, you might enjoy [[Music]]. What kind of music are you into?

homebody, rules out partying.message: Board games and reading. Not partying. A quiet night in with a film. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
homebody, rules out partying.reply: For board games, [[Gaming and Roleplay]] is a great fit, and [[Book]] is ideal if you enjoy reading. You might also like [[Film]] for a cozy movie night in.

sporty early riser.message: Football and the gym. Up early for a run, then football. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
sporty early riser.reply: It sounds like you have a great active routine already. For football, you might want to check out [[Sport]] to see what teams are available, and you can also browse the Societies page for more ideas.

lie-in and the cinema.message: Photography and the cinema. A lie-in, then the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
lie-in and the cinema.reply: That sounds like a lovely, relaxing day. If you enjoy films, you might like to take a look at [[Film]].

gamer, last minute (near tie).message: Gaming, Minecraft and FIFA. Gaming online late with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gamer, last minute (near tie).reply: For gaming and esports, you might like [[Esports]] or [[Gaming and Roleplay]]. Have you had a look at the Societies page to see what else is on offer?

clubbing (synonyms for partying).message: Going clubbing and festivals. Big nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
clubbing (synonyms for partying).reply: Since you love big nights out, clubbing and festivals, you'll definitely want to check out the Students' Union [[Events]] and [[Gigs]] pages.

outdoors, rules out the gym.message: Hiking and climbing. Not the gym. Up early for a long walk. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
outdoors, rules out the gym.reply: If you love getting up early for long walks and outdoor climbs, [[Walking]], [[Mountaineering]] and [[Outdoor Climbing]] would all be great fits for you. Have a look at the Societies page for more details on each of them.

unrelated to every mentor.message: Knitting and birdwatching. A trip to a nature reserve. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
unrelated to every mentor.reply: That sounds really relaxing and a great way to enjoy the outdoors. Have a look on the Societies page to see all the groups available.

only says what they don't want in 3 answ.message: I'm not into sport, clubbing or gaming. I don't like loud nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
only says what they don't want in 3 answ.reply: Thanks for letting me know what you prefer to avoid. What sort of things do you enjoy doing in your spare time?

quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.message: Reading and films. Quiet nights in, not nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.reply: That sounds like a lovely way to spend an evening. Since you enjoy reading and films, you might like [[Book]], [[Film]], or [[Creative Corridor]].

live music (synonym for gigs).message: Live music, mostly indie bands. Seeing a band, then drinks with friends. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
live music (synonym for gigs).reply: If you love indie bands and live music, check out [[Rock]] for getting together with other music fans, or have a look at the [[Gigs]] page for what is on.

interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.message: I'm not Ukrainian, but I'd love to learn more about Ukrainian culture and meet people. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.reply: That is wonderful, and everyone is welcome to join! You might like to take a look at [[Ukrainian]]. Have a browse of the Societies page to see what else catches your eye.

a mature student.message: I'm a mature student, so I'm a bit older than most people on my course. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a mature student.reply:
It is great that you are here, and there is a society specifically for people in your situation called [[Mature Students]]. 

Have a look at the Societies page to browse everything else available as well.

worried about money.message: I'm really worried about money. My loan won't last until the end of term and I don't know what to do.
worried about money.reply: I am sorry to hear you are feeling worried about money, but there is support available. You can take a look at [[Cost of Living]] for help with money worries in one place.

run out of money for food.message: I've run out of money for food this week and I'm not sure what to do.
run out of money for food.reply: I am sorry to hear you are dealing with that, but there is support available right through the university. Have a look at [[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] for help with food and money worries.

accused of plagiarism.message: I've been accused of plagiarism in one of my essays and I'm panicking.
accused of plagiarism.reply: I am really sorry to hear you are dealing with that, but try not to panic. You can get free, confidential guidance from the [[Advice Centre]] on academic misconduct.

landlord won't fix the damp.message: My landlord won't fix the damp in my flat and keeps ignoring my messages. Can I complain?
landlord won't fix the damp.reply: That sounds really frustrating to deal with, but you don't have to sort it alone. You can check out the [[Advice Centre]] page for guidance on housing issues and complaints.

how to contact a suggested society.first: I love knitting and crochet. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to contact a suggested society.firstReply: It sounds like you would love [[Hooked By Crochet]] or [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]], which are both great for getting crafty with others.
how to contact a suggested society.thenReply: To see details and contact buttons for them, take a look at [[Hooked By Crochet]] and [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]].

how to join a suggested society.first: I'm really into climbing and bouldering. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to join a suggested society.firstReply: It sounds like [[Climbing]] or [[Outdoor Climbing]] would be right up your street. Have you had a look at your checklist yet to see how you are getting on with everything else?
how to join a suggested society.thenReply: To find out more and see how to sign up, just take a look at [[Climbing]] or [[Outdoor Climbing]].

what a suggested society is like.first: I like board games and tabletop role-playing games. Are there any societies for that?
what a suggested society is like.firstReply: That sounds like fun, and there is definitely a society for that! You might like [[Gaming and Roleplay]]. Have a look on the Societies page to see more details.
what a suggested society is like.thenReply: If you want to know what it is like, have a look at [[Gaming and Roleplay]]. The app will show you all the details and how to get in touch.

a suggested society's Instagram.first: I love films and going to the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a suggested society's Instagram.firstReply: If you love watching movies, you might enjoy [[Film]]. Have a look at the Societies page to see what else is on offer.
a suggested society's Instagram.thenReply: If you want to find out how to contact them or see what they are up to, have a look at [[Film]] again for more details.
